description: JAT_Type elements are a sub element of JB_Type elements.
One element of each type is necessary to hold all data for the execution of one job.
One JB_Type element and x JAT_Type elements are needed to execute an array job with x tasks.
The relation between these two elements is defined in the
'JB_ja_tasks' sublist of a 'JB_Type' element. This list will
contain all belonging JAT_Type elements.
The 'JAT_Type' CULL element containes all attributes in which
one array task may differ from another array task of the
same array job. The 'JB_Type' element defines all attributes
which are equivalent for all tasks of an array job.
A job and an array job with one task are equivalent
concerning their data structures. Both consist of one 'JB_Type'
and one 'JAT_Type' element.
'JAT_Type' elements contain dynamic data which accrue during the
execution of a job. Therefore it is not necessary to create
these elements during the submition of a (array) job but
after the job has been dispatched.

attributes.name: task_number
description: Unique task number assigned during task creation.

attributes.name: status
description: First part of the state (see also JAT_hold, JAT_state).
@todo merge status, state and hold

attributes.name: start_time
description: Start time of the array task in microseconds since epoch.

attributes.name: end_time
description: End time of the array task in microseconds since epoch.
Only used in sge_execd to simulate job runs.

attributes.name: hold
description: Second part of the state (user, operator, system hold)
@todo merge status, state and hold

attributes.name: granted_pe
description: Name of a granted parallel environment (in case of parallel jobs).

attributes.name: job_restarted
description: Was the task restarted (due to reschedule/migrate)?
@todo it is no boolean, but misused for other information!

attributes.name: granted_destin_identifier_list
description: Granted destination identifier list (JG_Type).
Has one element per queue instance the job is running on.

attributes.name: granted_resources_list
description: List of granted resources, currently these are granted RSMAPs only.

attributes.name: master_queue
description: Name of the master queue.
@todo redundant information, it is the name of the first element in the GDIL.

attributes.name: state
description: Third part of state (see also JAT_hold, JAT_status).
@todo merge status, state and hold

attributes.name: pvm_ckpt_pid
description: Pid of a previous, checkpointed run of the job/ja_task.
@todo was apparently required for checkpointing/restart of PVM jobs - still needed?

attributes.name: pending_signal
description: Pending signal (not yet acknowledged by execd).

attributes.name: pending_signal_delivery_time
description: Time when a signal shall be delivered by sge_qmaster to sge_execd (repeated) in µs since epoch.
Also used in sge_execd to repeat sending of signals.

attributes.name: pid
description: Pid of the sge_shepherd of a job (child of sge_execd). Used for signal delivery.

attributes.name: osjobid
description: Unique id which applies to all os processes started
on behalf of this task. Set during the startup phase of the
job. Meaning depends on the architecture of the
host were the task is started.
SOLARIS/LINUX: additional group id
Could be / was a OS supported job id on no longer supported platforms
like Cray, Nec, Irix.

attributes.name: systemd_scope
description: In case a job is started in a systemd scope, this is the
scope unit name.
Only used in sge_execd, it is set during the startup phase of the
job.

attributes.name: systemd_slice
description: In case of tightly integrated parallel jobs, the job's tasks (master and slave)
are started within a slice. We only store it if we have a tightly integrated parallel job,
and this slice needs to be deleted after the job is finished.
Only used in sge_execd, it is set during the startup phase of the
job.

attributes.name: usage_collection
description: Usage collection mode of a pe task.
One of 0 (FALSE), 1 (PDC), 2 (HYBRID), 3 (TRUE).

attributes.name: usage_list
description: Raw usage from data collector. Scaled by sge_qmaster to JAT_scaled_usage_list.
Scheduling is using the scaled usage.

attributes.name: scaled_usage_list
description: Scaled usage set by qmaster, used by scheduler.
Usage scaling is defined in the exechost objects, see sge_host_conf.5

attributes.name: reported_usage_list
description: Usage which has already been reported in intermediate accounting records
in the reporting file. For long running jobs, written around midnight
to provide daily accounting information.

attributes.name: fshare
description: Functional shares associated with the job.

attributes.name: tix
description: Total number of tickets.

attributes.name: oticket
description: Override tickets.

attributes.name: fticket
description: Functional tickets.

attributes.name: sticket
description: Sharetree tickets.

attributes.name: share
description: Job targeted proportion set by scheduler.

attributes.name: suitable
description: Tag used in filtering in client job output (qstat, qhost).

attributes.name: task_list
description: List of running parallel tasks.

attributes.name: finished_task_list
description: List of finished parallel tasks - contains only task names.

attributes.name: previous_usage_list
description: Copy of the scaled usage list created when a job gets rescheduled.
@todo If a job is rescheduled multiple times, should probably be aggregated.

attributes.name: pe_object
description: PE object granted to this task (PE_Type) when it was scheduled.

attributes.name: next_pe_task_id
description: Used locally in execd to store next pe task id for this jatask on this execd.

attributes.name: stop_initiate_time
description: The time in µs since epoch when the action to initiate a job finish
(i.e. job termination, or checkpoint creation) was triggered or re-triggered.

attributes.name: prio
description: The priority derived from weighted normalized tickets and weighted normalized
static urgency. Changes with task due to GEEE ticket dependency.

attributes.name: ntix
description: Relative importance due to JAT_tix amount in the range between 0.0 and 1.0.

attributes.name: wallclock_limit
description: Wallclock_limit. Either requested (qsub -l h_rt=...) or the minimum of queue h_rt
in microseconds since epoch

attributes.name: message_list
description: Task specific messages.
Currently only used for storing the reason why a job is in error state.

attributes.name: deleted_by
description: Name of the user who deleted the array task (e.g. via qdel),
or the component which triggered the deletion (sge_qmaster, sge_execd).
Used for accounting and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: joker
description: Placeholder which can be used for arbitrary data.
Its purpose is to be able to add new attributes without changing the spooling format.
It is a list of arbitrary type and it is spooled.
